Defeat your enemies and find the treasures!

- Discover your way through the fort

Creator: Tanukiya

items.title: Jolicraft HD
items.creator: Jolicraft
items.description:
Life is a story you write yourself. Is yours worth telling? Craft a tale for the ages! Jolicraft can help.
+ Hand-drawn HD textures!
+ Critters, creepies, blocks, items, UI... Everything!
+ Includes 128x HD textures, 64x textures for mid-range devices, and original 16x "Classic" Jolicraft!
Complete Mounts of Mayhem update for Jolicraft HD (16x, 64x, and 128x HD)
items.changelog:
Complete Mounts of Mayhem update for Jolicraft HD (All resolutions - 16x, 64x, and 128x HD)
- Pale Garden with an extra creaky Creaking
- Cute new bats
- Derpy Copper Golems
- New Wolves, Ghasts, artwork, Nautilus, Chickens, Cows... SO MUCH STUFF!
